entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can look into this for you. Could I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Alex. I have your account pulled up. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or something else?
It's defective. The heart rate is completely wrong and now the whole thing won't sync with the app. It's basically broken.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. A device that won't sync is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, I've checked our policy, and it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for this defective band. I'll email you a prepaid return label right away.
Fine. So I just send it back?

That's correct. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging and attach the label. And because you're a VIP member, Alex, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for the inconvenience. You can use that on any future VeloFit purchase.
Whatever. Just make sure the label shows up.
It's already sent. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be issued in 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
